# Inherited manual automation sources

These scripts are retained as upstream reference source. ScreenWise has no active
GitHub workflows invoking them. They are not an approved setup, test or release
procedure and may refer to upstream services, packaging identities, unavailable
media, capture tools or destructive maintenance actions.

Do not execute them without reviewing the exact script, destination and required
authorization. Use CONTRIBUTING.md and the configured Windows interactive-test
kit for current developer procedures. `request-info-config.yml.disabled` is an
inactive copy of the former upstream bot configuration, not an enabled bot policy.
